title: Insurance Claim Services Category Reassessment: Regulated-Cleanup Difference on Category 3 Jobs
content:
**Rule.** In an Insurance Claim Services category reassessment supplement, the regulated-cleanup difference is set as follows: for a job dispatched at a Clean or Gray Water tier whose recorded category is category 3, when the file carries a scope omission supplement naming the water job that awaits the carrier's decision, the Black Water containment setup fee of the tier the job's affected area selects less the containment setup billed, plus the HEPA vacuuming square feet billed multiplied by the difference between the Black Water HEPA rate and the dispatch tier's HEPA rate, because the regulated cleanup that supplement claims is, on a category 3 job, performed to the Black Water standard, containment included; for such a job with no such pending supplement, only the HEPA vacuuming square feet billed multiplied by the difference between the Black Water HEPA rate and the dispatch tier's HEPA rate, because without regulated cleanup the containment setup serves the drying alone and stays at the dispatch tier's fee while HEPA vacuuming on a category 3 job meets the Black Water standard; otherwise no regulated-cleanup difference.

Records read: the Water Damage Mitigation job's tier, recorded category, affected area, containment setup lines and HEPA vacuuming lines; and, on the claim file, the scope omission supplements naming that job that no carrier approval yet decides.

## Black Water figures by affected area

| Figure | Standard Loss (below 2000 sq ft) | Large Loss (2000 sq ft or more) |
|---|---|---|
| containment setup fee | 445.00 | 400.50 |
| HEPA vacuuming rate per square foot | 0.52 | 0.47 |

## Combinations

| Clean or Gray Water tier, category 3 recorded | Pending scope omission supplement naming the job | Difference |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | containment fee less containment billed, plus HEPA square feet multiplied by (Black HEPA rate less the dispatch tier's rate) |
| yes | no | HEPA square feet multiplied by (Black HEPA rate less the dispatch tier's rate) only |
| no | any | none |

*Hypothetical:* a Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss job of 2600 square feet, recorded category 3, containment setup billed 355.50, 1500 square feet of HEPA vacuuming billed, dispatch tier HEPA rate 0.28. With such a pending supplement: 400.50 less 355.50 is 45.00, plus 1500 multiplied by 0.19 is 285.00, together 330.00. Without one: 285.00.
